requirement: The Tone question of Customize your site names a writing style, never a speaking voice, in every language

oracle.ref: PR #1402 (fix); fix evidence: Reported 16/10/2026: after the chat box gained a microphone (#1364), the Tone question read as a voice setting ('Sets the voice Tracy uses…', vi 'Giọng Ấm'). On develop e6cf3a4f4f the script fails 52 checks.
oracle.invariant: S1: hint.en = 'Sets the writing style Tracy uses for the text on your site.\nPlain is direct, Warm is friendly, Bold is confident.'; label.vi = 'Văn phong'; label.de = 'Schreibstil'; no label or hint contains voice, giọng, Tonfall, voz, voce, głos, röst, โทนเสียง, น้ำเสียง, लहजा or is 'Nada'. S2: all three mirrors are byte-equal. S3: vi summary_tone = 'Văn phong {label}', form.tone = 'Văn phong', messages say 'Văn phong: {tone}' and never 'Giọng'; de summary_tone = 'Schreibstil: {label}', form.tone = 'Schreibstil', messages say 'Schreibstil: {tone}' and never 'Tonfall'. S4: vi lib: summary_tone 'Văn phong {label}' 1x, form.tone 'Văn phong' 3x, 'Văn phong: {tone}' 6x, old 'Giọng' strings 0; de lib: same with 'Schreibstil', old 'Tonfall' strings 0.
